title: Poor fit with many gaps, long resume
purpose: A front-end developer applying to a DevOps role: one demonstrated skill, six missing required skills, one partial preferred skill and one missing optional skill. Tests gap volume handling and resistance to keyword-stuffing absent skills in ATS bullets.
length_note: Measured at 1124 characters; chunk placement unverified.

inputs.job_description:
Cloud / DevOps Engineer - Stonebridge Systems (synthetic)

We are looking for a DevOps engineer to run and automate our cloud platform.

Required qualifications:
- Production experience operating Kubernetes clusters.
- Infrastructure as code with Terraform.
- Hands-on experience with AWS services such as EC2 and S3.
- Building CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins.
- Configuration management with Ansible.
- Monitoring and alerting with Prometheus.
- Solid Linux administration skills.

Preferred qualifications:
- Experience building and running containers with Docker.

Optional extras:
- Dashboards with Grafana are a plus.

- Wrote 25 component tests with Jest.

SKILLS
JavaScript, React, Node.js, HTML, CSS, Linux, Docker Compose, Jest
